translation: Eli, Eli, ⟨por⟩ que me abandonaste? ⟨Estás⟩ distante de ⟨o⟩ meu livramento, ⟨nos⟩ ⟨dizeres⟩ do ⟨meu⟩ ⟨rugir⟩.

tokens.rationale: Hebrew interrogative; requires preposition 'por' in Portuguese
Adjective requires copula in Portuguese; 'distante' conveys remoteness
מישועתי is a hapax (unique word); 'livramento' from the root ישע (deliver/save)
Construct chain: 'dizeres' (from דבר, word) with implied preposition
My roaring/groaning; שאגה can mean roar or groan
